today.title: Today
today.lead: What waits on you, every day. Agents work in the background; nothing leaves your name without your say.
today.emptyBody: When agents find a job, prepare an application or draft a reply to a recruiter, it waits for you here. Start by telling them who you are and what you want next.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.lead: Every opportunity agents find or you add, from first match to offer.
pipeline.emptyBody: Jobs land here with how well they match your profile, their stage and the next step, so nothing slips.

agents.title: Agents
agents.lead: Each run works in its own sandbox, made for one job and deleted after.
agents.emptyBody: When a search or an application runs, you can watch what it does here as it happens: each step, the sites it reached and anything it was stopped from reaching.

profile.title: Profile & goals
profile.lead: What agents know about you. They use only what is written here, and every claim in a CV must trace back to it.
